_about: Filament's first-run tips: small bubbles beside one control each, shown once. Edit by hand; a page reload reads it again. enabled: false turns every tip off; a step's own enabled: false turns that one off. replayOnRestart: true shows every tip again after each restart of Filament (Settings › About › Restart Filament), and replayWelcomeTour opens the welcome tour too, from its first step. Keep replayOnRestart false in what ships. dim: how dark the page goes behind a tip, from 0 (not at all) to 0.9; a step's own dim is that tip's. A step: id (never reuse one), group (steps of a group show in a row, 1 of 3), target (a CSS selector), when (a page condition: subagent, context-half), after (a step to be seen first), place (top, bottom, left, right), title, text, dim.

steps.title: First, check the project
steps.text: Your agent reads and edits files in this folder, and the chat joins that project's Space and memory. Choose it before you send.

steps.title: When the chat gets full
steps.text: How the chat makes room near the model's limit. It starts from your defaults; a change here holds for this chat only. Later, click the ring by the message box.

steps.title: Who helps your agent
steps.text: Who your agent may use by itself, what they run on and where they edit. It starts from your defaults for this project; a change here is for this chat. Later: the gear in the Agents tab.

steps.title: A sub-agent is helping
steps.text: Everyone working for this chat shows in the Agents tab. Open it to follow each one's work as it happens.

steps.title: This chat's agent settings
steps.text: Who your agent may use and what each runs on, for this chat only. Edit defaults in Library sets them for every chat.

steps.title: Your agent made a plan
steps.text: Its tasks are drawn in the Plan tab in order, ticked off live as they run. The chat goes on as before.

steps.title: How full this chat is
steps.text: The ring fills as the chat grows. At its notch, the chat makes room as it's set to. Click it to see what fills it, or to change how.
